goal: Validate executable human code-task labels and an ordered feedback A/B protocol before scoring or promoting session intelligence
first_check: Aggregate test availability on the pinned existing SWE-bench train data: read only test_patch/FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS columns, emit counts and file hash without issue IDs, names, test content or patch text. Test metadata are not task solutions. Do not regrade prior frozen submissions as resolved bugs.
if_unavailable: Use an untouched official development split with prospective repository exclusions and hidden reference/test content. Pin sources/harness and check environment support before any actor sees tasks. Preserve official test split and consumed tasks; no official resolved percentage without the actual test harness.
comparison: Explicit view feedback must compete against stateless/search-only feedback and exact/lexical retrieval on fresh ordered source tasks. Compare real evidence and total context/call costs, including wrong acceptance/drift/abstention. One actor replaying a task is not an independent blinded agent comparison.
limits: No paid external APIs, public release, model training, tuning from consumed heldout recipes or forced accepted-file ranking. Isolated source workspaces may be used for benchmark tests; protect original source corpora.
